title: Sevenfold
summary: SEV'ENFOLD, adjective [seven and fold.] Repeated seven times; doubled seven times; increased to seven times the size or amount; as the sevenfold shield of Ajax; sevenfold rage. SEV'ENFOLD, adverb Seve

inlines.v: SEV'ENFOLD, adjective [seven and fold.] Repeated seven times; doubled seven times; increased to seven times the size or amount; as the sevenfold shield of Ajax; sevenfold rage. SEV'ENFOLD, adverb Seven times as much or often. Whoever slayeth Cain, vengence shall be taken on him sevenfold. Genesis 4:15.
